components.gap: The full treatment promised by the declared status 'proved' is not supplied for every assertion of the entry. The theorem asserts (body lines 349-350) that 'smoothing alone need not preserve the original CDF bound', i.e. that Gaussian smoothing of some member of K_eps can leave K_eps. The annex proof (lines 356-370) only shows that mixing with Phi first and then smoothing with s<=pi*delta*eps stays inside K_eps; its only smoothing estimate is an upper bound (sup|E Phi(x-sZ)-Phi(x)|<=s/pi). No example, computation or argument anywhere on the route (searched P15 body and annex) shows that smoothing alone fails, so this asserted case of the entry is unproved. Convexity, vague compactness, the mass bound 1-2eps and vague density of finite-information members are proved.

defect_observations.observation: Unproved assertion inside a proved theorem: 'smoothing alone need not preserve the original CDF bound'. A short witness exists (Gaussian smoothing of the least-favorable F_* with a<b pushes the completed CDF below Phi-eps on the interior of [a,b], because Phi is concave there), but none is written. Either supply it in annex:p15.huber.cdf.domain or move the sentence out of the theorem statement as an unproved remark.
